resources.string: The \"Nearby devices\" (Bluetooth) permission is needed to connect to your band.
This deletes the settings file that holds your band\'s address and key. Your recorded data (band.db) is kept.

Your band's Bluetooth address and auth key are needed. They don't come with the app.

To bring over your settings and history from a computer: close the app, send config.json (and band.db) from the computer using the "adb … run-as %1$s" commands in the README, then open the app again. (Dropping the files into the folder with a file manager or adb push won't work: Android doesn't let the app read them.)

Or enter them by hand below:
The address must look like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
The key must be 32 hexadecimal characters (0-9, a-f).
Smart Band runs in the background to stay connected to your band. The settings below keep it from being interrupted.
✓ Exempt: the system isn\'t restricting the app to save battery.
! Not exempt: the service may be stopped while the phone sleeps, and syncing may be delayed.

Samsung phones can put rarely used apps on the \"Sleeping apps\" list and stop them in the background. If you granted the battery exemption above, nothing else is needed: exempt apps aren\'t added to that list (which is also why they don\'t show up in the \"Never sleeping apps\" picker). If you didn\'t, you can choose \"Unrestricted\" under Battery in the app settings.
Start when the phone turns on
When on, the service starts by itself after the phone restarts and after the app is updated.
If you grant notification access, the app can read the notification text of the apps you choose. That text is only sent to your band over Bluetooth; it is never stored or sent to the internet.
! Notification access not granted: notifications and music won\'t work.
Only notifications from the apps you choose below are sent.
Don\'t send while the screen is on
No notifications go to the band while you\'re using the phone (screen on and unlocked).
When off, notifications that don\'t make a sound or vibrate on the phone aren\'t forwarded.
Send during Do Not Disturb too
When off, nothing is forwarded while the phone is in Do Not Disturb mode.
The name or number from the phone app\'s notification shows on the band; no extra permission is needed.

The current track shows on the band, and the band\'s buttons control the player on your phone. When nothing is playing, the band\'s play button starts your preferred player (or the last one that played).
! No notification permission: the status notification won\'t show (the service still runs).
! No Bluetooth permission: can\'t connect to the band.
Shuts down the service and the band connection so the desktop app or Mi Fitness can connect to the band. It won\'t start again by itself until you reopen the app.
The band connection closes and no data is collected. If a workout is being recorded, it picks up where it left off when you reopen the app.
If the chosen app has an active media session, the band shows and controls it; otherwise it falls back to the last one that played.
Shows that the Smart Band service is running, along with the band\'s connection and battery
Another app may be holding the band

location is off on the phone
